title: To What Extent Do Fluorophores Bias the Biological Activity of Peptides? A Practical Approach Using Membrane-Active Peptides as Models.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package, Data_Sheet_1 PDF text, supplementary landing bins, and linked database JSONL rows were sufficient for the owner-layer repair; no blocking source gap remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 11 linked DBAASP/DRAMP assay, experiment, activity, and literature rows were reconciled against article metadata, primary peptide sequences, Supplementary Table S3, hemolysis Table S4, cytotoxicity Table S5, and Table 1. Database-only/conflict placeholders were resolved to source_verified where supported; nonblocking metadata cautions are preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 activity rows were rebuilt from local primary/supplementary tables with real targets: human erythrocytes, HBEC-5i, MDA-MB-231, and BBB translocation model. The parser's column-heading species artifacts were removed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism output is bounded to fluorophore-bias, hemolysis, and cytotoxicity phenotype evidence; it does not overclaim direct molecular mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: The prior rwk-complete-test-0001 blocker is closed because the source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 owner layers now pass semantic and publication-quality gates with only explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No linked_sequence_records rows were packetized, so sequence adjudication used the primary article, Supplementary Table S3, and DRAMP raw row rather than a separate sequence snapshot.
DRAMP32317 has blank DOI metadata but links by PMID/title and has source-supported sequence/activity values.
The article tests fluorophore effects on membrane-active peptides; final mechanism ontology is intentionally phenotype-bounded.
landing-1.bin through landing-9.bin are Frontiers HTML pages; the recoverable source supplement is local-DRAMP-Data_Sheet_1.pdf/Data_Sheet_1.txt.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001. The paper is accepted_with_cautions: activity/toxicity rows are source-located with real targets, linked database rows are reconciled or explicitly cautioned, and mechanism claims are bounded to phenotype-level evidence.
